correctness.rationale: The defining binary trust-game worth has a direct unanimity decomposition for every graph. The Shapley value is the degree-half term plus the own external bonus and outgoing penalties; the binomial mark variables are independent because each selected destination has disjoint incoming ordered-arc trials. Poisson convergence yields the tagged law and moments; two-root bounded exploration yields the empirical law. In the critical window the expected number of nonisolated null players tends to zero, and factorial moments of directed isolates give the Poisson count. Independent coalition-marginal enumeration verified all 4164 digraphs through order 4, rational binomial-mixture equality and exact null/mean formulas. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The deterministic Shapley identity and binary model are explicitly prior work. The new stochastic theorem is not stated in the inspected full 2026 structural paper or originating 2024 full paper, and research-record/web queries found no directly covering statement. The Poisson isolate theorem alone does not imply when a zero-credit player is isolated; its model-specific equivalence is proved. Unindexed/implicit derivations remain a qualified risk.
residual_risks: General random-graph local weak convergence may enable a short rederivation from earlier deterministic formulas, but no concrete inspected theorem already states the exact trust-game distribution and critical window.
Unindexed exact studies and the uninspected full text of more general network centrality references could contain equivalent treatment.
Directed independent-edge, binary-weight model is deliberately narrow; weighted edge models may have different atom/threshold behavior.

value.rationale: For trust-based distributed reputation, the distribution of actual credit, the fraction left at zero despite positive mean, and the exact density at which all nodes first obtain positive credit are natural network-performance quantities. The theorem supplies a complete sparse tagged and empirical law plus an exact critical Poisson window; these are not just recomputations of the source’s deterministic graph formula or an arbitrary finite census.
